forward_evidence_score.purpose: Score settled frozen-forward rows candidate-vs-v28 on probability quality before economics or promotion.

forward_packet_freeze_handoff.purpose: One-command research handoff for validating a real sidecar packet CSV, freezing eligible rows, and materializing a registry-shaped handoff without promotion.

freeze_acceptance_gates: all packet contract groups are complete
candidate prediction comes from allowed_for_forward_collection manifest and frozen model_hash
settlement fields are absent before freeze
frozen prediction ledger is written before resolution

post_resolution_label_join.purpose: Attach labels only after frozen predictions and market resolution, then compute row-level probability metrics.

promotion_acceptance_gates: settled labels joined only after freeze and resolution
source contract reports promotion-grade forward rows
chronological holdout and post-lock forward rows beat v28 on Brier/log loss/calibration
near-boundary and recross slices improve or do not degrade
broad market coverage floor is met

public_rest_sidecar_batch.purpose: Research-only batch builder for turning active nearest-close BTC15M public markets into separate sidecar input bundles.

public_rest_sidecar_bundle.purpose: Research-only one-shot builder for turning current public Kalshi market/orderbook snapshots plus BTC candles into a sidecar input bundle.

spec.purpose: Handoff for collecting complete pre-resolution packet rows and frozen collection-candidate predictions for later post-lock scoring.
research_only_guardrails: Do not change live order logic, strategy thresholds, secrets, live state, or processes.
Capture and score sidecar rows only.
Settlement labels are forbidden before freeze and must be joined only after resolution.
allowed_for_forward_registry remains false until settled forward evidence clears promotion verifier.

sidecar_adapter.purpose: Reference implementation for turning passive book checkpoints plus decision-time BTC/v28/candidate inputs into packet-contract rows before close.

sidecar_batch_evidence_score.purpose: Apply probability-first evidence scoring to non-canonical sidecar batch labeled rows without granting promotion.

sidecar_bundle_batch_handoff.purpose: Batch research handoff for broad-market sidecar bundle directories before label join and forward evidence scoring.

sidecar_bundle_batch_label_join.purpose: Post-resolution label join for non-canonical sidecar batch frozen rows, kept separate from the promotion ledger.

sidecar_bundle_batch_settlement_labels.purpose: Post-close public Kalshi settlement label fetch for sidecar batch frozen rows, written to a separate label CSV.

sidecar_bundle_freeze_handoff.purpose: One-command research handoff from sidecar input bundle to packet rows and non-promoting freeze/registry-shaped artifacts.

sidecar_collection_cycle.purpose: Repeatable one-cycle sidecar collector/freeze/label/score/audit runner for accumulating forward evidence without writing canonical promotion ledgers.

sidecar_input_bundle_contract.purpose: Validate the serialized market/checkpoint/BTC/v28/candidate input bundle before packet collection.

sidecar_packet_collector.purpose: Executable research-only bridge for emitting complete YES/NO candidate packet rows from an open-market checkpoint or serialized input bundle before freeze.
